package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

// TargetCatalog resolves canonical competency identities owned by Learning Planner.
// Callers must provide normalized, unique refs and must not infer newer versions.
type TargetCatalog interface {
	ResolveExact(ctx context.Context, targets []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetRef, error)
}

// TargetDiscoveryCatalog returns a bounded authoring vocabulary. Discovery is
// advisory; consumers must still resolve every selected exact identity.
type TargetDiscoveryCatalog interface {
	DiscoverByStacks(ctx context.Context, stacks []string, limit int) ([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, error)
}
